examples.english: Thereafter Jesus saw a woman who came to make repentance. | He had baptized her three times, and yet she had not done what was worthy of the baptisms. And the Saviour desired to try Peter, to see if he was compassionate and forgiving, as he had commanded them.

examples.english: “and moreover because those mysteries are compassionate and forgive at every time.”
